propositions: A new advisory, agent-tier, container plan-review criterion (decomp-shape) must detect layer-cake decomposition splits (children partitioned by architectural layer rather than vertical slices) and consumed-artifact-without-ordering-edge patterns (siblings with producer-consumer artifact relationships but no ordering dependency)

The decomp-shape criterion must be registered in CANONICAL_LLM and AGENT_TIER (not CODEBASE_GROUNDED), added to CONTAINER_CRITERIA, and routed with facet=container, scope=[container], and default_posture=advisory

The criterion implementation must provide two sub-answers: has_container_decomposition (gate: passes if parent has <2 children) and decomposition_shape_sound (fires on layer-cake or unordered artifact consumption)

The eval_solver container-arm must be extended to run container criteria via pass1_container when fixtures carry a children: list, enabling bounded sanity evaluation with <=8 live single-criterion container runs
E6 judge order-stability (fleiss_kappa=0.55, below 0.6 floor) is a prerequisite blocker for promotion to blocking; advisory shipping is unaffected and safe under judge instability

Bounded sanity evaluation with hand-authored fixtures (2 positives: layer-cake and consumed-artifact; 2 negatives: vertical-slice and ordered producer-consumer) must achieve recall=1.0 and false-accept=0.0
